alignmentPolicy: Record upstream separately; do not replace product version with upstream version.

notes.baseline: This distribution was built from the dsh-v0.1.7-rc.1 sources (commit ca58174).
notes.verified: On 2026-09-28 the dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2 sources (commit 477b4f420553e8a52c2fbccc464d7561b239c443) were downloaded and reviewed against this tree.
notes.mergeDecision: rc.2 is not merged in this release. The upstream delta is large (scheduled tasks/reminders, desktop onboarding, keyboard shortcuts, dynamic tool additions, and roughly 2,850 changed files), while this distribution carries extensive local modifications across the same client packages. Merging requires a deliberate rebase of those customizations onto rc.2, tracked as follow-up work; this file records the verified upstream state, not a merged state.
